mapper.select: SELECT id, staff_id, service_id, status FROM staff_service_capability WHERE service_id = #{serviceId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, merchant_id, store_id, start_at, end_at, configured_capacity, status, version FROM schedule_availability_window WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'SOLD_OUT') AND start_at < #{toAt} AND end_at > #{fromAt} ORDER BY start_at, id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_reservation_claim c JOIN schedule_reservation r ON r.id = c.reservation_id WHERE c.window_id = #{windowId} AND r.status IN ('TEMP_LOCKED', 'CONFIRMED')

SELECT id, merchant_id, store_id, start_at, end_at, configured_capacity, status, version, updated_at FROM schedule_availability_window
ORDER BY start_at, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, store_id, staff_id, start_at, end_at, status, version, updated_at FROM staff_availability_window WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND staff_id = #{staffId} ORDER BY start_at, id
